description: Defines an enumeration 'GlobalEntityType' representing various global entity types within the Fineract project, including their associated integer values and string codes, along with utility methods for mapping and retrieval.

classes.name: GlobalEntityType
classes.description: An enum class that encapsulates various global entity types with associated values and codes, and provides methods for lookup and string representation.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the entity type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the entity type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves the GlobalEntityType enum constant corresponding to the given integer value.

methods.name: fromCode
methods.description: Retrieves the GlobalEntityType enum constant corresponding to the given string code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant as a string.
